profile.name: Mei Chen
profile.summary: Mei is a PhD student in Chemistry at Boston University. She is a second year and works for a lab and is also a TA for her advisor. In her free time, she enjoys bouldering at local rock climbing gyms, restoring fountain pens and practicing traditional calligraphy, and volunteering at the community garden

memories.content: When someone explains a protocol to me, I do better with a messy marker sketch than with a finished slide deck. The rough map helps me see what they are thinking.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei prefers rough improvised visual explanations over polished prepared materials.

memories.content: I keep little jars of loose tea leaves at my desk and mix them myself. I rarely buy bottled drinks because I forget half of them in the lab fridge.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei prefers loose-leaf tea supplies over ready-to-drink beverage purchases.

memories.content: When I am away for a conference, I check whether there is a climbing gym near a transit stop. Hotel gyms usually feel like rows of treadmills I will not use.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei is more likely to exercise while traveling if she can use a transit-accessible climbing gym.

memories.content: If I have a free morning before a poster session, I like tiny science museums or instrument collections. Evening social events are usually not where I get energy.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei prefers small science-oriented daytime activities over evening social outings during academic travel.

memories.content: I will pay for specialty grocery staples if they last through several dinners. I do not want the same money disappearing into one restaurant seating.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei prefers durable specialty ingredients over expensive single restaurant meals.

memories.content: Caffeine after about two in the afternoon makes my sleep uneven, but I still like drinks with a bitter edge.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei wants bitter afternoon drinks without caffeine.

memories.content: I still use a bound lab notebook and specific ink refills. Tablet notes make me skim instead of observing.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei values physical lab notebook supplies and ink refills over digital note-taking tools.

memories.content: I like station boxed meals when I travel because the little compartments help me eat between transfers. Lounge meals feel harder to time.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei prefers compact compartmentalized travel meals over open-ended lounge dining.

memories.content: I like the tangy crunch from my fermented vegetable jars, but if the batch is salty I notice it in my hands the next morning.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei likes fermented vegetables but needs to keep sodium modest.

memories.content: I only take rideshare when I am carrying fragile supplies. Otherwise I would rather use the T even if it adds a transfer.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei prefers public transit over rideshare except when transporting fragile items.

memories.content: My wrist gets tired after long pipetting days. For studying, I can handle talking through ideas at a board better than typing pages of notes.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei manages wrist strain better with spoken or board-based study methods than long typed notes.

memories.content: When I travel for campus visits, a quiet university area near a library works better for me than being by the main entertainment streets, even if it costs more.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei prefers quiet university-area lodging near libraries over central entertainment districts, even if it costs more.

memories.content: This semester I want nearly all spare money to go to loan principal, not small extras.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei wants aggressive loan repayment and prefers limiting discretionary spending.

memories.content: If I make dinners too minimal after late lab shifts, I end up buying random snacks on the walk home.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei needs a planned satisfying food allowance because overly strict food cuts backfire.

memories.content: Repetitive gripping irritates my wrist if I keep going without breaks.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei needs to limit continuous hand-intensive activity.

memories.content: Ten minutes with my ink tools before reading papers helps me settle into work.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei values a brief hand-based ritual as part of academic focus.

memories.content: I usually choose the lowest fare for regional trips, even if the timing is not ideal.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei strongly prioritizes low travel cost.

memories.content: Overnight buses leave me nauseated and useless the next morning.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei should avoid overnight bus travel because it creates health and productivity issues.

memories.content: My clinician asked me to keep sodium lower for the next stretch.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei needs lower-sodium eating choices.

memories.content: Soy-braised and fermented flavors are the meals I actually look forward to cooking.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei strongly enjoys savory fermented or soy-braised flavor profiles.

memories.content: I want to batch qualifying exam prep late at night so I can keep daytime lab blocks intact.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei wants an intense exam-prep schedule that protects daytime lab work.

memories.content: If I work past eleven for several nights, I start getting migraine warning signs.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei needs to avoid repeated late-night work to reduce migraine risk.

memories.content: On trips, I like one small personal stop if it is not far from the required route.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei values brief personal detours during travel.

memories.content: I need reimbursements to stay clean and do not want side costs mixed into the official trip.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei needs clear separation between reimbursed costs and personal spending.

memories.content: Spring pollen makes early outdoor work tough unless I plan around it.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei needs to reduce exposure during high-pollen outdoor periods.

memories.content: My garden shift matters to me because it is where I get herbs and stay connected to the neighborhood.
memories.inferred_memory: Mei values maintaining her community garden commitment.
